subject: Post-call recap: platform fit, procurement path, and ops risks for Helix Bio
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.zhou@helixbio.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Platform fit, procurement path, and ops risks for Helix Bio

Claire — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

High-level business goals you shared:
- Reduce inference tail latency from ~900ms to <250ms for the triage pipeline (90th pct).
- Move 24/7 model inference for clinical alerts to a managed endpoint with predictable per-token cost (target: <$0.003/token for production throughput).
- Ensure HIPAA-aligned handling for patient data and auditability for 6+ months.

Top pain points / risks you called out:
1) Data residency & PHI: current procurement requires customer-managed VPC or a validated SOC 2 + encryption-at-rest policy.
2) Auditability: need exportable audit logs and queryable request traces for clinical audits.
3) Procurement timeline: internal legal and security review runs on a 3-week cadence — you indicated an Aug 31 procurement checkpoint.

What we proposed on the call:
- Dedicated (reserved) capacity on dedicated VPC option, or Private deployment if you require on-prem/appliance.
- Provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II pack and technical audit artifacts (KV cache behavior, retention policies, encryption config).
- Work with your procurement team on a 60-day pilot agreement that maps to measured latency and cost SLAs.

Immediate next steps (owners & timing):
- Evelyn: send MAP (mutual action plan) + infra diagram (attached) — delivered now.
- Marcus: share redacted SOC2 evidence and a short tech note on encryption/key management by 2027-08-23.
- Claire / Anil: share procurement contact and target PO/contract owner by 2027-08-24.

Escalation lanes to note (executive):
- If legal/security need further artifacts beyond redacted SOC2, escalation to our CISO team (Lauren) will be required.
- If pilot performance misses agreed latency targets during the initial 2-week run, we will trigger a performance review and prioritized runtime tuning.

Attachments: MAP_Helix_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), infra-diagram.png (deployment sketch) — both attached below.

Happy to jump back on a short call if any item above needs rewording.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0134

Evelyn — thanks for the tidy recap and MAP. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement timeline: Aug 31 is our internal buying committee sync; to hit that we need pricing + draft contract language by EOD Aug 26 so legal can queue it.
2) Security pack: we will need a SOC 2 Type II report and an outline of your data retention controls. If you can provide a redacted pack that would be ideal for our security team to triage pre-Aug31.
3) SLA expectations: we require 99.9% availability for production endpoints and a remediation path if latency SLOs are missed. Can you confirm the standard SLA and whether an elevated SLA is available for Dedicated?

Procurement lead is Anil Mehta (cc'd) — he will coordinate contracting and can loop in our procurement vendor team if needed.

Happy to be on a quick alignment call Wed (Aug 25) morning if that helps move items faster.

Cheers,
Claire
Head of Data Platform | Helix Bio

Claire / team — quick technical follow-up on the SOC2 / SLA / deployment options you asked about: 

SOC2 & artifacts:
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report: SOC2-Redwood-2026-redacted.pdf (attached stub) and a short security runbook describing retention windows and access controls.
- Encryption: data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.3). For Private deployments or VPCs we support customer-managed KMS keys (BYOK) and HSM integrations.

SLA & Dedicated option:
- Hosted API SLA (standard): 99.5% monthly availability.
- Dedicated (reserved) pools: we offer an elevated SLA up to 99.9% subject to committed throughput and network topology — we can scope this into the pilot order.

Operational traceability:
- Audit logs include per-request ID, timestamp, model variant, and route used; logs are exportable to S3 or your SIEM for 12 months by default (configurable).

Proposed near-term cadence:
- Marcus to share redacted SOC2 and the security runbook by EOD 2027-08-24 (link to artifacts included).
- Proposed short call to align on contract language + SLA tradeoffs: Wed 2027-08-25 09:00 PT (we can propose an alternative time if that conflicts).

Attachment stubs: SOC2-Redwood-2026-redacted.pdf

— Marcus
